home.title: Makan — Remember every meal
home.description: Makan is the food diary you keep with friends. Save what you ate, where you ate it and who was there — free on iPhone.

Hero.lineOne: Three weeks ago you ate something
Hero.body: Save what you ate, where you ate it and who was there.

Memory.title: The meals that matter deserve to be remembered.
Memory.body: The photo usually survives. The place, the people and why it mattered usually do not.
Memory.diaryAlt: Makan diary showing a month of saved meals

How.title: One photo does most of the work.
How.step1Body: Open the camera and save the meal while it is still in front of you.
How.step2Body: Tag the place and the people at the table. Write as much or as little as you want.
How.step3Body: The meal stays in your diary, with the date and details attached.
How.caption: Her first day at the new job.
How.composerPrivacy: Leaving without posting keeps this private.

EatOrYeet.title: The best meal is the one you'd eat again first.
EatOrYeet.body: Makan puts two meals from your diary head to head. Pick the one you'd go back for. Each choice shapes your Top 4 and a full ranking of your own meals.
EatOrYeet.closer: Your nan's roast or the 2am kebab? No one else gets a vote.
EatOrYeet.figureLabel: Eat or Yeet comparing two meals from a personal Makan diary
EatOrYeet.question: Which would you eat again first?
EatOrYeet.tap: Tap the one you'd order again first

ForYou.title: For people who keep the photo and lose the details.
ForYou.body: Makan is a personal food record that happens to be shared with friends. Every meal goes into your diary, and you choose Public or Friends Only when you post.
ForYou.signal1Body: The picture survives in your camera roll. The name of the restaurant usually does not.
ForYou.signal2Title: You ask friends where to eat.
ForYou.signal2Body: Seeing what they actually ordered is more useful than another average from strangers.
ForYou.signal3Body: No calories, macros or reason to perform for people you do not know.

Showcase.title: Your whole food life, in one place.
Showcase.body: Your diary keeps the meal. The map keeps the place. Friends help with whatever comes next.
Showcase.screenAlt: Makan {feature} screen shown in an iPhone mockup
Showcase.diaryBody: Your calendar becomes a food diary of breakfasts, late dinners and everything between them.
Showcase.journeyTitle: See your taste become a story.
Showcase.journeyBody: Your places, streaks and memories build into a record that is yours.
Showcase.friendsBody: See real meals from people you know in the Friends feed.
Showcase.mapBody: Tagged places appear on your map, so the answer is still there.
Showcase.detailsTitle: The whole story of a meal.
Showcase.detailsBody: Keep what you ate, where, when and who was there together.

Why.title: Built around the meal, not the metric.
Why.body1: Makan keeps a diary of your own meals, a chronological feed for friends and a separate Public feed for discovery.
Why.body2: The app has logged {count} meals. Each one carries the details its owner chose to add.
Why.body3: Your meal can be Public or Friends Only. That choice is made in the composer, meal by meal.
Why.principle1Body: It is sorted by time, not by likes or craves.
Why.principle2Body: Your first post is Friends Only. After that, choose an audience for each meal; Makan remembers your last choice.
Why.principle3Title: The details stay with the meal.
Why.principle3Body: The photo, date, meal type, caption, place and tagged friends are saved together.

Final.body: Start with the next meal you do not want to lose. Free on iPhone; choose Public or Friends Only.
Final.androidBody: It's in the works. Get one email when it launches.

Partner.metaDescription: Claim your restaurant on Makan and connect with diners who remember where they ate.
Partner.heroTitle: The app people open when they don't know what to order.
Partner.heroBody: Makan is the app people open when they're staring at your menu and don't know what to pick. It answers using what your regulars already order, never ads and never star ratings.
Partner.maitreDTitle: Your best regular, with a title.
Partner.maitreDBody: Someone becomes the Maître d' of your restaurant by actually showing up: two visit-days inside 60 days, and whoever comes most holds the spot. Earned by eating, never bought. When they lose it the handover is quiet, with no shaming, and they can win it back by coming in again.
Partner.maitreDGuide: They can leave a short guide to your place: 'Always get this,' 'Try this if…,' 'Good to know.' A real regular telling everyone else what to order.
Partner.maitreDAlready: You already do this for the regulars you know by face. Makan just writes it down, so every new diner gets the advice they would give.
Partner.stat1Body: of restaurant revenue is driven by repeat guests, across more than 100 million guest records.
Partner.stat2Body: of guests say staff remembering their name or usual order matters more than anything else. That is more than double the 22% who put a points-based reward first.
Partner.rewardsBody: Good rewards are small and personal: a saved table, a coffee on the house, first taste of a new dish, a small sign that you noticed. Pick whatever suits your place.
Partner.rewardsRule: The reward is for showing up. It is never for leaving a review.
Partner.do1: Sign up once. Confirm you're the real place.
Partner.do2: No new gadget, next to nothing for staff. When a new diner redeems an offer, your staff glance at their code and tap once to confirm. That is the whole job.
Partner.do3: You don't track anything. Makan works out who your Maître d' is.
Partner.newBody: Run a discount for diners nearby who haven't tried you yet. You only pay when it actually brings someone through the door, and you choose when it runs. The deal sits beside the honest recommendation. It never buys it.
Partner.costsFree: Nothing to be on it. Appearing on Makan is free. We don't charge you to be found, and we never take a cut of the meal.
Partner.costsPerk: The perk for your Maître d'. A free coffee costs you a dollar in beans. A saved table costs nothing.
Partner.costsDiscount: The discounts you run to pull new faces in, and those only cost you when someone actually turns up.
Partner.costsFlat: When you run a new-diner offer, you pay a flat Rp 10,000 the one time a genuinely new diner walks in and redeems it. It's flat rupiah, never a percentage, and it never touches your regulars.
Partner.costsNever1: Never a fee to appear or be found.
Partner.costsNever2: Never a cut of the meal or the bill.
Partner.costsNever3: Never a monthly charge, or anything for a diner you'd have had anyway.
Partner.rule1: No pay-to-win. You can't buy a better ranking, a fake regular, or a nicer write-up.
Partner.rule2: No forced discounting. Nobody makes you run a deal. It's a tool, not a toll.
Partner.rule3: No hidden fees on your diners' spend. We don't sit between you and your customer's bill.

AccountDeletion.metaDescription: Request permanent deletion of your Makan account and associated data, and see what is deleted or retained.
AccountDeletion.title: Delete your Makan account
AccountDeletion.intro: Use this page to request permanent deletion of your Makan account and the data associated with it. You can submit the request even if you no longer have the app installed.
AccountDeletion.requestBody: Email Makan from the address linked to your account, if you still have access to it. We will verify that the account is yours before deleting it.
AccountDeletion.cta: Email Makan to delete my account
AccountDeletion.noSecrets: Never send us your password, Apple password, Google password, or a sign-in code.
AccountDeletion.step1Body: Use the button above or email support@makanofficial.com with the subject “Delete my Makan account.”
AccountDeletion.step2Body: Include your Makan username or display name, the account email, and whether you signed in with Apple, Google, or email and password.
AccountDeletion.step3Body: We may reply with a limited identity check. This protects your account from someone else requesting its deletion.
AccountDeletion.step4Body: We will confirm when the request has been completed. Account deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
AccountDeletion.deletedItem1: Your Makan sign-in account, email, user ID, username, profile details, and profile photo.
AccountDeletion.deletedItem2: Your meal posts, photos, captions, meal details, audience settings, and place tags stored by Makan.
AccountDeletion.deletedItem3: Your friendships, friend requests, blocks, social streaks, rankings, badges, and saved app preferences.
AccountDeletion.deletedItem4: Your likes, craves, comments, reactions, notifications, referrals, and other records tied to your Makan account.
AccountDeletion.deletedItem5: Makan data stored locally by the app is cleared when you complete deletion inside the app; you can also remove the app or clear its storage on your device.
AccountDeletion.retainedItem1: Resilience backups may retain encrypted copies for up to 35 days before they rotate out.
AccountDeletion.retainedItem2: Security and abuse-prevention logs may be retained for up to 180 days.
AccountDeletion.retainedItem3: Limited records may be kept longer where the law requires it or where they are necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
AccountDeletion.retainedItem4: Anonymous or aggregated information that can no longer identify you may remain. Copies shared outside Makan are outside our control.
AccountDeletion.retentionBody: After we verify the request, Makan deletes or anonymises personal data within 30 days. Backup copies can remain for up to 35 days, and security or abuse-prevention logs can remain for up to 180 days with restricted access.
AccountDeletion.optionalTitle: You can also delete inside the app
AccountDeletion.optionalBody: Open Makan Settings, scroll to the bottom, tap Delete Account, then confirm Delete My Data. You will be asked to verify your identity using the sign-in method on your account.
AccountDeletion.otherTitle: Only want to delete some data?
AccountDeletion.otherBody: You can ask Makan to remove selected data while keeping your account active.

DataDeletion.metaDescription: Ask Makan to delete selected personal data without deleting your account, and see what is deleted or retained.
DataDeletion.title: Delete selected Makan data
DataDeletion.intro: Use this page to ask Makan to remove specific personal data while keeping your account active. Tell us exactly what you want removed and we will confirm what can be deleted.
DataDeletion.requestBody: Email Makan with the data or content you want removed. Your account and anything you do not request will stay active unless we explain that a specific item cannot be separated from the account.
DataDeletion.emailSubject: Delete selected data from my Makan account
DataDeletion.cta: Email Makan to delete selected data
DataDeletion.noSecrets: Never send us your password, Apple password, Google password, or a sign-in code.
DataDeletion.step1Body: Name the exact item or category to remove, such as a meal photo, caption, comment, reaction, profile photo, display name, or support enquiry.
DataDeletion.step2Body: Include your Makan username or display name, account email, and useful details such as the meal date or restaurant. Do not include a password.
DataDeletion.step3Body: We may reply with a limited identity check before changing account data. We will explain if deletion of the requested item would require deleting the account.
DataDeletion.step4Body: We will confirm what was deleted and what remains. Your Makan account stays active unless you separately request account deletion.
DataDeletion.deletedTitle: What you can ask us to delete
DataDeletion.deletedItem1: Specific meal posts, photos, captions, meal details, audience settings, or place tags.
DataDeletion.deletedItem2: Specific comments, likes, craves, reactions, notifications, friend requests, or other social activity linked to you.
DataDeletion.deletedItem3: Your profile photo, display name, or other profile details that are not required to keep the account operating.
DataDeletion.deletedItem4: A support or website enquiry and the personal details submitted with it.
DataDeletion.deletedItem5: Related Makan-controlled indexes or copies that identify the same requested item, where applicable.
DataDeletion.retainedItem1: Your Makan account, sign-in method, and minimum account identifiers needed to keep it active.
DataDeletion.retainedItem2: Meals, photos, profile details, friendships, and activity that you did not ask us to delete.
DataDeletion.retainedItem3: Resilience backups for up to 35 days and security or abuse-prevention logs for up to 180 days.
DataDeletion.retainedItem4: Limited records required by law or for legal claims, plus anonymous information that can no longer identify you.
DataDeletion.retentionBody: We process verified requests within the time limits required by law. Once selected data is removed from active Makan systems, backup copies may remain for up to 35 days and security or abuse-prevention logs may remain for up to 180 days. If you choose full account deletion instead, personal data is deleted or anonymised within 30 days.
DataDeletion.optionalTitle: Some data can be removed in the app
DataDeletion.optionalBody: You can delete your own meal posts and profile photo from Makan. Use the email request when you cannot access the app, want a broader category removed, or need help identifying the data.
DataDeletion.otherTitle: Want to delete the whole account?
DataDeletion.otherBody: Account deletion removes the Makan account and the data associated with it, and cannot be undone.

Metadata.title: Makan — Know what to order
Metadata.description: Take a photo of what you eat. Makan works out what you like, and what people keep ordering where you are. Then it tells you what to order. Free on iPhone.
Metadata.ogSub: Take a photo of what you eat. Makan tells you what to order.

Hero.headline: You still don't know what to order.
Hero.legal: V vegetarian · VG vegan · GF gluten free. Prices in thousands of rupiah, subject to 21% government tax & service.
Hero.proofLead: Eat or Yeet is a tiny game. Two meals you've saved. Which would you eat again first?
Hero.proofTally: Your picks tell Makan what you like.
Hero.eoyQuestion: Each pick tells Makan one thing about your taste.
Hero.crowdTally: Other people's picks tell it what gets ordered again at Bright Palm. Put together, that's the barramundi.
Hero.crowdPrivacy: Nobody sees your picks and you don't see theirs. Makan only uses the totals.
Hero.openLine: Open Makan at the table. It says what to order here.

FirstDay.intro: Holiday, night one. A menu you don't know.
FirstDay.turn: Makan has never seen you eat here. But a friend has, three times, and ordered the chicken rice every time.
FirstDay.turnWhy: You'd have texted them to ask. Makan already knows.
FirstDay.friendMealSub: Three visits in August. Chicken rice every time.
FirstDay.friendMealAlt: Chicken rice at Lucky Plaza, saved on Makan on {date}
FirstDay.slipAlways: The chicken rice, with the soup and extra chilli.
FirstDay.slipTry: You want it lighter. Ask for poached, not roasted.
FirstDay.slipKnow: They sell out most days by 8.
FirstDay.nowhereQ: And the noodle cart on the corner that nobody on Makan has tried?
FirstDay.emptyState: Not enough meals here yet to help you choose.
FirstDay.emptySub: Makan tells you that instead of guessing. Save what you order, and the next person gets an answer.
FirstDay.legal: Prices in thousands of rupiah, subject to 21% government tax & service.
FirstDay.maitredIntro: Then there's the Maitre'D. That's whoever has eaten here the most.
FirstDay.maitredWho: Mali has eaten here on 23 different days, more than anyone else on Makan. If someone beats that, the notes become theirs.

Landing.trustRating: Rated {rating} on the App Store ({count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}})

Not.title: Six things Makan leaves out on purpose.
Not.l2: A restaurant can't pay to be the pick. Ever.
Not.l3: A dish gets picked because people order it again, not because it has the most photos.
Not.l4: No calories, no scores. Just the photo and what you called it.
Not.l5: You don't have to save every meal. Save the ones worth remembering.
Not.climaxEyebrow: And the one that matters most
Not.climaxBody: When Makan hasn't seen enough meals at a place, it says so on the menu instead of picking one at random.

Final.title: Next time you don't know what to order.
Final.body: Snap what you eat. Play Eat or Yeet now and then. Next time you sit down with a menu, Makan has an answer.

Restaurants.title: Your best regular, with a title.
Restaurants.body: Whoever eats at your place most on Makan becomes its Maitre'D. Two visits inside 60 days to qualify, and whoever comes most holds it. Earned by showing up, never bought, and they can lose it to someone who comes more. They leave the notes every new diner reads.
Restaurants.p1: Being on Makan is free. No fee to appear, no cut of the bill.
Restaurants.p2: Reward your Maitre'D however you like. A saved table, a coffee on the house. Cheap for you, big for them.
Restaurants.p3: Nobody can buy the pick. A deal for first-timers sits next to the honest answer, marked as a deal.
Restaurants.stat1Body: of restaurant revenue comes from repeat guests.
Restaurants.stat2Body: of guests say being remembered matters more than points.
Restaurants.doTitle: What you have to do: almost nothing.
Restaurants.do1: Sign up once. Confirm you're the real place.
Restaurants.do2: When a new diner redeems an offer, staff glance at their code and tap once.
Restaurants.do3: You don't track anything. Makan works out who your Maitre'D is.
